'''Enhanced Jabba's Palace''' is the 22nd Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in January 2000. It is twelve premium cards in four unique die-cut packs (4 Light Side, 8 Dark Side). CardGuide numbering: 22nd product.

Each pack has three premiums (the first visible through the window) plus four [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] boosters. MSRP $14.95; 12 packs per box. The four Jabba's Palace boosters are reprints and are not listed.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

The four window cards are [[See-Threepio (Enhanced Jabba's Palace)|See-Threepio]], [[Master Luke]], [[Boushh]], and [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]].

Some Enhanced Jabba's Palace cards leaked into ''Star Trek'' CCG ''The Trouble with Tribbles'' packs. Decipher offered replacement boosters if those cards were returned.<ref name="encyc" />

== Print sheets ==
Premiums print 11&times;11 (121 cards). Dark Side: 9 titles 13&times; plus 4 blanks. Light Side sheet layout is unknown in the encyclopedia.<ref name="encyc" />
